# Sthuthi Securities

> Authorized cybersecurity testing, remediation, and retesting for web applications, APIs, cloud systems, SaaS products, and AI agents.

Sthuthi Securities is a product from Sthuthi Technologies, LLC. Public material describes scoped services, pricing, assessment methods, security practices, field guides, worksheets, and evidence-led security articles. Demo workspaces, authentication routes, draft legal pages, and internal delivery screens are not public reference material.

## Primary pages

- [Home](/): Security testing for applications, cloud systems, and AI agents.
- [Services](/services): Service boundaries, pricing, timing, access needs, and deliverables.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starting prices and commercial scope.
- [How assessments work](/how-it-works): Authorization, scoping, testing, reporting, remediation, and retesting.
- [Security and data handling](/security): Evidence, access, retention, secrets, and provider boundaries.
- [Resources](/resources): Seven long-form security guides and their downloadable worksheet packs.
- [Security field notes](/blog): Research and practical guidance for security buyers and engineering teams.
- [Discuss a project](/request): Assessment scoping request.

## Security services

- [Penetration Testing](/services/penetration-testing): A customer or auditor asked for a pen test report, or you have never had one.
- [AI Security Assessment](/services/ai-security-assessment): You shipped an AI feature, copilot, or agent that can take actions and nobody has tried to break it.
- [SaaS and Cloud Security Assessment](/services/saas-cloud-security): You are not sure what is public, what tokens exist, or which third-party app can read your data.
- [Software Supply Chain Security Review](/services/supply-chain-security): You ship software and have never checked the packages, credentials, and release process it depends on.
- [Phishing and Social Engineering Resilience](/services/phishing-resilience): Your help desk can reset access, your team moves money, or fake-executive calls are a concern.
- [Compliance Readiness](/services/compliance-readiness): A deal is stuck on a security review, or an audit is coming.
- [Security Fixes and Retesting](/services/security-fixes-retesting): You have findings and need engineers to fix them and verify the changes.
- [Ongoing Security Testing](/services/ongoing-security-testing): You release often and need agreed workflows checked again as the product changes.
- [Incident Response Planning and Recovery Testing](/services/incident-response-planning): Your team needs a tested plan for stopping an incident and restoring critical services.
- [Fractional Security Lead (vCISO)](/services/fractional-security-lead): You need a named senior lead to own the program and handle customer security reviews.

## Security field notes

- [Agentic AI Security in 2027: When Your AI Can Act, What Can Go Wrong?](/blog/agentic-ai-security): A complete 2027 guide to agentic AI security: why agents are riskier than chatbots, the real 2026 incidents, the main risks, how to test, and how to secure an AI agent.
- [Best AI Penetration Testing Companies (2027 Guide)](/blog/ai-penetration-testing-companies): A 2027 buyer's guide to AI penetration testing companies: who's independent, who got acquired into a platform, pricing signals, and how to actually pick one.
- [Best AI Pentesting Tools (2027 Guide)](/blog/ai-pentesting-tools): A 2027 guide to AI pentesting tools: open-source LLM scanners (garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo, Giskard), commercial platforms, and which tool to actually use.
- [Best AI Red Teaming Companies (2027 Guide)](/blog/ai-red-teaming-companies): A 2027 guide to AI red teaming companies: who's independent, who got acquired, automated platforms vs human-led services, and how to evaluate a vendor.
- [AI Red Teaming vs Penetration Testing: Which One Do You Need in 2027?](/blog/ai-red-teaming-vs-penetration-testing): AI red teaming vs penetration testing, explained: what each one is, how they differ, when to use which, what each costs, and how to decide for your AI system.
- [How Much Does an AI Security Assessment Cost? Real 2027 Pricing Guide](/blog/ai-security-assessment-cost): What an AI security assessment costs in 2027, what drives the price up or down, what you get at each tier, and how it compares to a pen test. Real ranges, no 'contact us' dodge.
- [Best AI Security Companies (2027 Guide)](/blog/best-ai-security-companies): A 2027 map of AI security companies: full platforms, independent specialists, testing firms, and GRC/compliance platforms — labeled so you don't confuse the categories.
- [Chatbot Security Testing in 2027: Stop Your Bot Leaking Customer Data](/blog/chatbot-security-testing): A complete 2027 guide to chatbot security testing: the real risks, how testing works, a real example, what it costs, and how to secure an AI chatbot before launch.
- [HIPAA Security Assessment and Penetration Testing (2027 Guide)](/blog/hipaa-security-assessment): Does HIPAA require a penetration test? The current rule, the proposed 2025 HHS update that would make it mandatory, and what a HIPAA-relevant test should cover.
- [ISO 27001 Penetration Testing Requirements (2027 Guide)](/blog/iso-27001-penetration-testing): Does ISO 27001 require penetration testing? The honest answer, what Annex A 8.8 actually requires, what a credible pentest needs to show, and what it costs.
- [LLM Penetration Testing in 2027: Finding the Holes a Scanner Misses](/blog/llm-penetration-testing): What LLM penetration testing is, how it differs from app testing, what it checks, the methodology, what it costs, and how to secure an LLM application in 2027.
- [Best LLM Security Companies (2027 Guide)](/blog/llm-security-companies): A 2027 guide to LLM security companies: runtime guardrails vs testing-only tools, who's independent, who got acquired, and how to choose for your LLM app.
- [MCP Server Security in 2027: The New Attack Surface Nobody's Testing](/blog/mcp-server-security): A complete 2027 guide to MCP server security: what MCP is, the five ways it gets attacked, what testing checks, and how to secure the tools your AI agent can reach.
- [OWASP LLM Top 10 Explained: Every Risk With Real Examples (2027 Guide)](/blog/owasp-llm-top-10): A complete 2027 guide to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications — every risk from LLM01 to LLM10, a real example of each, how to test for it, and how to mitigate it.
- [Prompt Injection Testing in 2027: Can Your AI Be Talked Into Leaking Data?](/blog/prompt-injection-testing): A complete 2027 guide to prompt injection testing: what it is, direct vs indirect attacks, a real example, what a test checks, how it's done, and whether it can be prevented.
- [SaaS and Cloud Security Assessment (2027 Guide)](/blog/saas-cloud-security-assessment): What a SaaS and cloud security assessment actually checks: identity, OAuth grants, connected-app risk, and cloud configuration — and how it differs from a pentest.
- [How to Answer a Security Questionnaire (SIG, CAIQ, and Custom) — 2027 Guide](/blog/security-questionnaire-help): How to answer a SIG, CAIQ, or custom vendor security questionnaire fast: what evidence actually gets you through, and what to do if you're starting from zero.
- [SOC 2 Penetration Test in 2027: What Auditors Actually Require](/blog/soc2-penetration-test): Does SOC 2 require a penetration test? The honest 2027 answer, what auditors actually expect, Type 1 vs Type 2, how often you need one, cost, and what the report must show.
- [Web Application Penetration Testing (2027 Guide)](/blog/web-application-penetration-testing): A complete 2027 guide to web application penetration testing: the OWASP WSTG 12 categories, black-box vs gray-box vs white-box, how often you need one, and cost.
- [What Is AI Penetration Testing? A Plain-English Guide for 2027](/blog/what-is-ai-penetration-testing): What AI penetration testing is, how it differs from a normal pen test, what it checks, how the process works, who needs it, and what it costs in 2027.
